product_metadata.title: Signature Design by Ashley Honnally Modern Medallion Pattern Accent Chair, Blue & Ivory
features: ACCENT CHAIR IS A CONVERSATION PIECE: Dramatic turned spindle elements, rich finish, and soft linen-like upholstery with abstract medallion pattern turn up the wow factor on this chic accent that's the perfect addition to the living room, entryway or bedroom.
BUILT WITH NOTABLE DETAILS: Handsome chair is crafted with a corner-blocked frame, loose back and tight seat cushions.
INTRICATE COMPOSITION: Elegant armchair features turned spindle leg, a rich umber-hued faux wood finish, and high-resiliency foam cushions wrapped in thick, and vivid medallion pattern.
GREAT FOR MID-SIZE SPACES: Accent chair measures 21"W x 29"D x 32"H
DIRECT FROM THE MANUFACTURER: Ashley Furniture goes the extra mile to package, protect and deliver your purchase in a timely manner.
ASSEMBLY REQUIRED: Fits through doorways 30" and wider.

BUY WITH CONFIDENCE: Designed and manufactured by Ashley Furniture Industries. The trusted source for stylish furniture, lighting, rugs, accessories and mattresses. For every taste and budget. Since 1945.
description: With its sense of softness and subtlety, this accent chair can slip right into just about any scene. Billowy and beautiful, the multi-tonal upholstery pattern is wonderfully easy on the eyes. The unique design and fabric of an arm chair or armless chair can turn it into quite a conversation piece. Our chairs are available in all different styles, sizes and shapes, with coverings that include genuine leather, microfiber or deeply tufted upholstery. You’ll find plenty of accent chairs that combine beautiful design with quality materials to create a welcoming seat. And we go the extra mile to package, protect and deliver your purchase in a timely manner.
